title: World Modeling through Spectral Alignment
abstract: How do we tell a world model what information to preserve? We study this question through the lens of spectral representation learning. We introduce SpecWM, a JEPA framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce those relationships in its embedding geometry. Different kernels provide different supervision, ranging from physical state information to a fully self-supervised temporal kernel requiring only the ordering of observations within trajectories. We characterize the global optima of the objective, establish conditions for linear recoverability and invariance to nuisance information, and connect temporal-kernel similarity to the behavioral successor measure under an idealized setting. Empirically, the choice of kernel strongly controls which physical quantities are recoverable from the representation. More importantly, temporal spectral alignment improves CEM planning success over LeWorldModel from 52% to 68% on OGBench Cube, 49% to 77% on OGBench Scene, and 29% to 51% on CALVIN. These results suggest that explicitly specifying representation geometry provides a simple way to steer what latent world models preserve for control.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods, today's lecture is on World Modeling Through Spectral Alignment. Recent work such as Le World Model: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels and Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning explores how latent predictions can support planning. This paper, by researchers affiliated with Stanford and ETH Zürich, takes a complementary direction: it makes the desired relationships among observations explicit. That matters because a useful world model must decide what information to keep, not just how to predict.
segments.zh: 在深度强化学习方法这门课里，今天讲的是通过谱对齐进行世界建模。最近的一些工作，比如Le World Model: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels和Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning，探索了潜在预测如何支持规划。而这篇论文，由斯坦福和ETH苏黎世的研究人员合作完成，走了一个互补的方向：它把观测之间期望的关系显式地表达出来。这一点很重要，因为一个有用的世界模型必须决定保留哪些信息，而不仅仅是怎么做预测。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Yes, Noah? The key tension is that images contain far more detail than a planner needs, but discarding the wrong detail can make control fail. Earlier approaches often rely on prediction objectives or regularization to shape an embedding indirectly. Here, the authors ask whether we can specify the geometry more directly. That question puts representation design—not merely prediction accuracy—at the center of the discussion.
segments.zh: 是的，Noah？关键的矛盾在于，图像包含的细节远远超过规划器所需要的，但丢掉不该丢的细节又会导致控制失败。早期的方法通常依赖预测目标或正则化来间接塑造嵌入。而在这里，作者提出的问题是：我们能不能更直接地指定这种几何结构？这个问题把表征设计——而不仅仅是预测精度——推到了讨论的核心位置。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, when you say geometry, do you mean the model is learning which observations should count as similar?
segments.zh: 教授您好，您说的几何，是指模型在学习哪些观测应该被视为相似吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The method uses a teacher similarity kernel to state which pairs of observations ought to be close in the learned space. An encoder is trained to match that geometry. The teacher can use physical state or depth when those signals are available, but it can also use frame order or learned goal-reaching distances. So the central contribution is a configurable way to guide what a latent world model preserves.
segments.zh: 完全正确。这个方法用一个教师相似度核来规定哪些观测对在学习到的空间里应该彼此接近。编码器被训练去匹配这种几何结构。当有物理状态或深度信号时，教师可以用它们，但也可以用帧顺序或学到的目标达成距离。所以核心贡献是提供了一种可配置的方式，来引导一个潜在世界模型保留什么信息。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: This is useful because avoiding collapse does not guarantee that a representation keeps control-relevant information. Imagine a robot camera where the robot arm is visually prominent, while the object to be moved is small. A representation could distinguish arm configurations very well yet encode object location poorly. By choosing a kernel that emphasizes relevant relationships, the designer can make the intended distinctions part of the learning target.
segments.zh: 这一点很有用，因为避免坍缩并不能保证表征一定保留了控制相关的信息。设想一个机器人相机的场景：机械臂在画面里很显眼，而要移动的物体却很小。一种表征可能很擅长区分机械臂的各种构型，但对物体位置的编码却很差。通过选择一个强调相关关系的核函数，设计者就可以把真正想要的区分能力变成学习目标的一部分。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: what does the temporal teacher actually consider similar?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：这个时序教师到底把什么当作相似？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It uses the distance between frame indices within a trajectory: nearby frames are treated as more similar than frames farther apart. The observations are converted into a kernel, then its shared baseline is removed by centering. The authors also temper the spectrum, retaining up to 128 directions and reducing the dominance of the largest eigenvalues. This produces a target geometry that the encoder can match through its pairwise inner products.
segments.zh: 它用的是轨迹里帧索引之间的距离：离得近的帧比离得远的帧更相似。观测被转换成一个核，然后通过中心化去掉它共享的基线。作者还对谱做了平滑处理，最多保留128个方向，并削弱最大特征值的主导地位。这样就产生了一个目标几何结构，编码器可以通过它的成对内积来匹配。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The second critical piece is action-conditioned prediction. The model encodes an observation, combines that embedding with an action, and predicts the next embedding. Training asks the prediction to match the encoder’s representation of the next observation, while a separate spectral alignment loss shapes the encoder’s pairwise geometry. At planning time, the model rolls candidate action sequences forward and scores their predicted embeddings against a goal observation.
segments.zh: 第二个关键部分是动作条件预测。模型先编码一个观测，再把得到的嵌入和动作结合起来，预测下一个嵌入。训练时要求预测结果匹配编码器对下一个观测的表示，同时用一个单独的谱对齐损失来塑造编码器的成对几何结构。到了规划阶段，模型会把候选动作序列向前展开，并用预测出的嵌入与目标观测进行打分。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the kernel shapes what the encoder represents, while the predictor supplies the dynamics used for planning?
segments.zh: 所以核函数决定了编码器表征什么，而预测器则提供规划时用到的动态信息？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That’s the distinction. The planner uses the Cross-Entropy Method, or C-E-M, to search over action sequences. It repeatedly samples candidates, keeps the better-performing ones, and adjusts its sampling distribution toward them. The paper reports average success rates of 68% and 71% for temporal and quasimetric teachers on OGBench Cube, compared with 52% for LeWorldModel. Temporal SpecWM also leads on OGBench Scene and CALVIN in the reported comparisons.
segments.zh: 这就是区别所在。规划器用的是交叉熵方法，也就是CEM，在动作序列上做搜索。它会反复采样候选动作，保留表现更好的那些，然后让采样分布向它们靠拢。论文报告说，在OGBench Cube上，时序教师和拟度量教师的平均成功率分别是68%和71%，而LeWorldModel是52%。在论文给出的对比中，时序SpecWM在OGBench Scene和CALVIN上也领先。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The results are encouraging for planning, but the representation probes tell a more nuanced story. For object-position prediction, temporal SpecWM’s reported R-squared scores are 0.81 on Cube, 0.78 on Scene, and 0.47 on CALVIN. LeWorldModel scores 0.98, 0.09, and 0.41. So a strong linear probe score does not automatically imply better goal-directed control; the planner’s needs and the probe’s target are not identical.
segments.zh: 这些结果对规划来说挺鼓舞人心的，但表征探针给出的情况更微妙一些。在物体位置预测上，temporal SpecWM 报告的 R 平方分数在 Cube 上是 0.81，Scene 上是 0.78，CALVIN 上是 0.47。LeWorldModel 则是 0.98、0.09 和 0.41。所以线性探针分数高，并不自动意味着目标导向的控制就更好；规划器的需求和探针的目标并不是一回事。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify how the experiments support the claim that the kernel controls what information is retained?
segments.zh: 你能说明一下这些实验是如何支持“核函数决定了保留哪些信息”这一说法的吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The kernel ablations show that changing the teacher changes which physical variables are recoverable. On OGBench Scene, the fully specified state kernel reaches an average R-squared of 0.93. Proprioception-focused kernels preserve robot configuration but often do poorly on object or fixture variables. Temporal and quasimetric kernels are underspecified across different trajectories, leaving the encoder more freedom. These comparisons support a link between the chosen relationships and accessible information.
segments.zh: 核函数的消融实验表明，更换教师会改变哪些物理变量可以被恢复。在 OGBench Scene 上，完全指定的状态核函数平均 R 方达到 0.93。以本体感觉为核心的核函数能保留机器人构型，但在物体或固定装置变量上往往表现不佳。时序核函数和拟度量核函数在不同轨迹之间指定不足，给编码器留下了更多自由度。这些比较支持了所选关系与可获取信息之间的联系。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: There are limits to what the results establish. The evaluation covers simulated visual manipulation benchmarks and one C-E-M planning pipeline, not physical robots or diverse real-world environments. Temporal similarity also depends on trajectory order and data coverage. The theoretical connection between temporal similarity and a behavioral successor measure relies on an idealized Markov setting and the data-collection policy. The authors further report that adding action-noise failure rollouts improves both methods.
segments.zh: 这些结果能说明的问题也有局限。评估只覆盖了模拟的视觉操作基准和一个C-E-M规划流程，没有涉及实体机器人或多样化的真实环境。时间相似性还依赖于轨迹顺序和数据覆盖范围。时间相似性与行为后继度量之间的理论联系，依赖于一个理想化的马尔可夫设定以及数据收集策略。作者还报告说，加入动作噪声失败轨迹能同时提升两种方法。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this approach relate to earlier J-E-P-A work, and what remains open?
segments.zh: 这种方法与早期的JEPA工作有何关联，又有哪些问题仍未解决？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Le World Model and related J-E-P-A systems learn predictive embeddings with regularization, while this paper makes pairwise similarity an explicit target. That changes the design question from merely keeping embeddings varied to specifying which distinctions matter. Its theory characterizes spectral solutions and conditions for recovering labels or removing nuisance variation. Still, choosing an effective kernel at larger scale remains unresolved, and probe performance is not a dependable substitute for measuring planning directly.
segments.zh: Le World Model 和相关的 JEPA 系统通过正则化来学习预测性嵌入，而这篇论文把成对相似度变成了一个明确的目标。这就把设计问题从仅仅保持嵌入的多样性，转变为指定哪些区分是重要的。它的理论刻画了谱解以及恢复标签或消除干扰变异的条件。不过，在大规模下如何选择有效的核函数仍未解决，而且探针性能并不能可靠地替代对规划的直接测量。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader lesson is that a latent world model is shaped not only by its prediction task, but also by the relationships its training objective asks it to preserve. Spectral alignment offers a way to expose that choice and test its consequences. Its practical value depends on matching the teacher geometry to the task and the available data. Remember this: a planner can only use what its representation makes visible. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 更广泛的启示是，潜在世界模型不仅由它的预测任务塑造，也由训练目标要求它保留的关系所塑造。谱对齐提供了一种方式，把这一选择暴露出来并检验其后果。它的实用价值取决于教师几何是否与任务和可用数据相匹配。记住这一点：规划器只能利用其表征让它看见的东西。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
